title: About Us
text: NP Consultants is a structural design and engineering consultancy established in 2010, providing comprehensive solutions across Sri Lanka and extending its services to international projects. With expertise in structural design, structural detailing, architectural and interior design, project management, and electrical and mechanical consultancy, we serve a diverse range of projects, from residential buildings to industrial facilities and specialised structures. Our experienced team is committed to delivering practical, reliable, and cost-effective solutions tailored to each client's requirements, with a strong focus on quality, structural integrity, and client satisfaction.
